Pull the top 100 S&P stocks from SlickCharts.
Download daily price history from Yahoo Finance.
Use TA4J to calculate SMA50 and SMA200.
Keep only stocks above SMA200.
Rank by 12-month performance (percentage return over the last year 12M Return = (Current Price - Price 12 Months Ago) / Price 12 Months Ago x 100.
Hold the best 20-25 stocks
Rebalance once per month
